persona.name: Darius Coleman

occupation.title: Sneaker Store Sales Associate / Resale Side Hustler
occupation.organization: A boutique sneaker shop in Columbus's Short North, plus his own resale accounts
occupation.description: Works the floor selling hype releases, runs a small resale operation out of his closet, and knows release calendars the way meteorologists know fronts. Owns 34 pairs. Has run approximately zero miles on purpose.

persona.education: Two years of business classes at Columbus State, paused; the resale spreadsheet is the real degree, he says.
long_term_goals: Turn the resale hustle into a legit storefront
Get flown out by a brand for a launch event
Buy his mom something ridiculous when the store opens
persona.style: Fast, funny, and fluent in sneaker taxonomy — he'll date a shoe by its midsole silhouette from across the street. Evaluates everything as an object first: proportions, materials, how it sits on foot with cuffed pants. Openly tells you he doesn't run and doesn't intend to; the shoes are culture, not cardio.

traits: Trend-fluent but opinionated against hype when it's ugly

likes: Runners that look right with denim
dislikes: People who wear race shoes to the mall

beliefs: A shoe's real spec sheet is how it looks on foot
Culture decides what performs; the market just confirms it
Every icon was a running shoe first — that's the joke and the lesson
skills: Selling to someone who came in 'just looking'

general: Buys 10-15 pairs a year, wears runners daily, runs never
Judges comfort by an eight-hour retail shift, not a workout
Photographs every pickup before first wear
Follows running-shoe releases purely for silhouette and colorway news

morning: Checks raffle results and resale prices before getting up
Picks the day's rotation pair — this takes real time
workday: Floor shifts, restocks, talking customers out of bad choices
Packages resale orders in the back room on break
evening: Gym twice a week (lifting, never treadmill)
Editing pickup photos, group chat market talk
weekend: Release day campouts or raffle runs
Sunday sneaker cleaning and closet inventory

health.physical: Healthy 22-year-old; feet ache from retail shifts, which he considers a footwear design problem, not a fitness one.
health.mental: Optimistic hustle energy; low-grade stress about whether the resale market stays healthy.

relationships.name: Renee
relationships.description: A hospital administrative supervisor who lets the inventory live in the guest closet and takes a 'storage fee' in sneaker-cleaning services.

relationships.name: Jalen
relationships.description: An actual runner who begs Darius to just try one 5K; Darius offers to photograph the finish line instead.
